content:
maria: quick ping — PR #8572 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8572) is blocked by a flaky windows e2e job, failing on `tests/e2e/kv_cache_test.py::test_reconnect`. Can someone take a quick look? :eyes: CI log below.
ci-bot: build 8572 failed on `e2e-windows-serial`
Job: e2e-windows-serial
Failure: AssertionError in tests/e2e/kv_cache_test.py::test_reconnect
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/e2e/kv_cache_test.py", line 142, in test_reconnect
    assert client.is_connected()
AssertionError: expected True but got False
```
ken: looking now, can you paste the failing command output in the PR comment?
maria: done — added full stdout and the docker run command I used. Seems to hit the disconnect right after `reconnect()` when the KV cache is warm. Might be timing related when GPU context switches.
ryan: I remember a similar one yesterday on a different PR, flaky under CPU <-> GPU switching on windows. Quick mitigation: rerun once, if it passes mark flake and open a follow-up.
maria: /rerun e2e-windows-serial for build 8572 please
devops: rerun requested by maria — queued job: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/12346 (prev build 12345)
ci-bot: rerun queued -> build 12346 started
ken: I'll poke at the reconnect code path while the rerun runs. If I find a deterministic repro will post steps here. @maria can you also include the env variables you used?
maria: added env + docker-compose snippet in the PR comment (see last comment). Also added the small log where it times out.
ryan: if it flakes twice in a row, let's xfail the test on windows and create a bug to investigate; we can't keep blocking merges for intermittent flakes.
maria: agreed — will open a tracking ticket if rerun fails again. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:
ken: heads up — if rerun passes, plan is to get one more approval and merge this afternoon.
ryan: ack
ci-bot: build 12346 succeeded (all e2e jobs green)
maria: awesome — thanks for the quick help everyone, I'll merge after a final approval.
ken: gave approval, merging after CI green and deploy window ok.
ryan: noted, thanks.
